{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Use pd.to_numeric to safely convert revenue, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
invalid_conversions = sales['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()
print("Number of revenue values that failed to convert:", invalid_conversions)

# Check if any QA orders (999999.99) are present
qa_mask = sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
print("QA orders found (revenue_numeric == 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_sales = sales[
    (sales['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

print("Number of rows after filtering:", len(filtered_sales))

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = filtered_sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Display conversion rates
conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
